newsitem.title: CHILE: CHILE'S ELECTROANDINA SIGNS $150 MLN LOAN.
newsitem.headline: CHILE'S ELECTROANDINA SIGNS $150 MLN LOAN.

text.p: Chilean power firm Electroandina said it has signed a seven-year $150 million syndicated loan with a group of 13 foreign banks led by Citibank.
The funds will be used to pay debt owned by to Chilean state copper company Codelco which sold the power generator to Electroandina's owners last year.
Codelco sold a 51 percent stake in the firm for $178 million to a group including Spanish firm Iberola Energia de Espana, Belgian companies Powerfin SA and Tractebel and Chilean company Enagas SA.
Codelco still owns 34 percent but plans to sell its shareholding on the bourse. The rest is held by workers.
Electroandina used to be known as Compania Termoelectrica Tocopilla.
